services.desc: New Jersey law requires that all operators of motorized boats obtain a boating license and a boating safety certificate before they can operate in non-tidal waters. Non-tidal waters include lakes, creeks, and rivers unaffected by tidal conditions. Even out-of-state residents must carry written proof of their successful completion of a boating safety course in order to operate a boat in New Jersey legally. A boating license and a boating safety certificate are not to be confused; both are required in New Jersey. Fortunately, these credentials are not hard to obtain. blurb: Guests can rent modern, meticulously cleaned and serviced pontoon boats equipped with Bluetooth radios, removable tables, ample storage, and comfortable seating. The boats have large swim platforms, bimini tops, and life jackets for safety. The lake offers opportunities for cruising, swimming, fishing, and docking at waterfront restaurants and bars.
